source: Transcribed from the Rigol DSA800 Series Spectrum Analyzer Programming Guide (Aug. 2016). Both the setting and the query form of each command are printed in the guide's own Syntax block, so nothing here is generated by rule. All 197 commands named in the guide's per-subsystem Command List tables are present. Commands the guide marks with an asterisk need an option (EMI filter, tracking generator, VSWR) the base DSA815 does not carry.
